content: I will write a script `scratch/decrypt_categories.js` that decodes the UTF-16LE raw KV file, decrypts it using the PBKDF2 master key derived from the PIN `0509`, and outputs the decrypted budget categories to a new file so we can inspect them for detailed calculation tables (subItems).
